title: MW6 full-game production completion
completionDefinition: The MW6 parent closes only after the remaining MW6U-AA production tracks have verified assets, menus, save hardening, content tools, balance fixtures, release gates, browser acceptance, and updated canon.

tracks.label: Bible and world canon
tracks.summary: Production bible, 12-city atlas, campaign outline, systems bible, and validation rules are canonical.
acceptance: 12 major cities and 48 sub-cities validate
Campaign, races, classes, companions, and systems are typed

tracks.label: Prologue story foundation
tracks.summary: The prologue now has a detailed non-combat opening: player-created protagonist identity, Bellroot Vestibule, Descent Ledger, oath-lamps, Ilo, Gate Monolith, and first quest flags.
acceptance: No forced protagonist name or gender
Opening begins with identity, exploration, and Ilo before combat
Quest and lore flags are reusable by runtime, codex, saves, and future intro UI

tracks.label: Character foundation
tracks.summary: Eight lineages, eight class trees, subclasses, palettes, skills, v3 identity, and Hero/Skills drawers are live.
acceptance: Character selection persists
Skill unlock/equip stays local-first

tracks.label: Combat, enemies, armory, world loop
tracks.summary: Enemy taxonomy, armory/economy, quests, factions, companions, NPCs, route events, and world loop proof are live.
acceptance: 12/48 world content is represented
Travel, reputation, companion, crafting, and salvage loops work

tracks.label: Dungeons and endgame
tracks.summary: Repeatable dungeons, relic trials, boss rematches, treasure maps, arena challenges, collections, and cosmetics are live.
acceptance: Endgame state persists
Postgame activities update local save

tracks.label: Image-driven browser RPG shell
tracks.summary: Adventure cards, click-to-travel/fight/loot/story controls, and game-first browser RPG presentation are live.
acceptance: First viewport reads as game surface
Command input remains usable

tracks.label: Save, balance, release gate foundation
tracks.summary: Dedicated save, balance, and release readiness scripts plus fixture-backed production drawer proof are live for the remaining MW6W-AA closeout.
acceptance: Save fixtures cover v2, raw v3, envelope v1, and corrupted import paths
Balance and release matrices are validated and visible in /hq

tracks.label: Menu and save runtime bridge
tracks.summary: The /hq Production drawer now shows the complete 14-panel menu index with launcher buttons, and the Room drawer exposes autosave/manual/checkpoint slot summaries plus a three-slot save envelope.
acceptance: All menu panels are visible in the game UI
Menu launcher buttons route to existing drawers
Autosave, manual, and checkpoint slots export together without cloud saves

tracks.label: Production asset pipeline
tracks.summary: Finish illustrated 2D production, CC0/CC-BY/project-original/commercial-license intake, guarded MIT sprite tooling records, sprite/model/audio normalization, visible credits, production readiness checks, and manifest enforcement.
acceptance: No unverified assets ship
Every committed asset has source, license, author, role, dimensions, and credit posture

tracks.label: Illustrated 2D asset bench
tracks.summary: High-quality illustrated 2D is now the primary visual production path, with project-original seed sheets for portraits, enemies, locations, gear, and skill/VFX icons plus prompt/provenance validation.
acceptance: Illustrated assets render in /hq
Prompt/provenance records gate generated or operator-provided output
Real 3D intake remains optional and blocked until local packs exist

tracks.label: Hero Kit image assets
tracks.summary: Operator-approved GPT Image 2/Codex image generation produced the first Hero Kit batch: 3 hero portraits, 3 class outfits, 12 weapon/item icons, and 8 armor/equipment icons, all normalized, manifest-tracked, and visible in /hq drawers.
tracks.runtimeSurface: /hq Assets, Hero, Kit, and Armory drawers
acceptance: Generated source sheets have prompt/provenance records
Runtime Hero Kit sheets pass manifest validation
Hero, Inventory, and Armory surfaces prefer approved Hero Kit art where available

tracks.label: Hero Kit runtime presentation
tracks.summary: Approved Hero Kit portraits, outfit cards, weapon/item icons, armor icons, location cards, and enemy cards now lead live /hq RPG surfaces: persistent loadout icons, click-RPG hero strip, Adventure map/encounter/loot cards, and class-choice art.
tracks.runtimeSurface: /hq playfield HUD plus Adventure, Hero, Inventory, and Armory drawers
acceptance: Runtime surfaces use approved illustrated assets before procedural fallback
Adventure cards expose location/enemy/reward art
Class selection includes Hero Kit image-led choices

tracks.label: Hero Kit visual style lock
tracks.summary: The approved Hero Kit character, outfit, weapon, and armor sheets now define the visual quality target for future Aether Reliquary art. A dedicated visual-direction contract and validator keep flat glyph batches rejected/reference-only.
acceptance: Hero Kit assets are the approved style target
Rejected prologue glyph sheets stay rejected/reference-only
Future visual batches are queued against high-fidelity painted/rendered 2D art

tracks.label: High-fidelity asset briefs
tracks.summary: The next 44 production assets now have validated Hero Kit-quality prompt briefs covering enemies/bosses, Bellroot prologue replacement art, weapon quality variants, and 12 city cards.
acceptance: Briefs are anchored to the Hero Kit style target
44 assets have prompts, sheet specs, and acceptance criteria
Flat glyph/dashboard art language is blocked before generation

tracks.label: Enemy/boss hifi art and Bellroot intro
tracks.summary: Promote the enemy-boss high-fidelity card batch into runtime and make Bellroot open as a non-combat story flow before fighting unlocks at the Warden's Antechamber.
acceptance: Enemy and boss cards use approved high-fidelity art
Bellroot starts with ledger, lamps, Ilo, gate, Loom-Shard, and forge beats before combat
No forced protagonist name or gender appears

tracks.label: First town release slice
tracks.summary: Shape the first release around Bellroot into the north-gate route and Veyrhold as the first intentional open town, with four district cards playable and the remaining 11 cities locked as future-act previews.
acceptance: Veyrhold is the only open first-release town after the north-gate route
Four Veyrhold districts are visible as town cards
Other cities remain locked preview content until later MW6 slices

tracks.label: Veyrhold town services
tracks.summary: Deepen Veyrhold into the first release hub with blacksmith, alchemy, market, inn, oath-board services, four district hooks, and starter armor/accessory progression for helm, armor, gloves, boots, rings, and amulet.
acceptance: Five Veyrhold services are visible after town opens
Starter gear progression covers armor and accessory slots
Services use existing local-first actions and drawers

tracks.label: Veyrhold NPCs and mini-quests
tracks.summary: Add named Veyrhold locals, district mini-quests, and service outcome cards so the first town feels inhabited and rewards are understandable before broader city slices open.
acceptance: Five named Veyrhold locals are visible in People
Four district mini-quests are visible in Map
Five service outcomes are visible in Journal and use local-first reward actions

tracks.label: Veyrhold district hub runtime
tracks.summary: Turn Veyrhold's four districts into a compact visitable town-hub board that links each district to NPCs, services, mini-quests, rewards, and durable visit flags.
acceptance: Four district hub nodes are validated
Each node links to local NPCs, services, jobs, and rewards
The /hq Map drawer lets players visit a district and records local-first progress

tracks.label: Oathmarket vendor and job runtime
tracks.summary: Make Oathmarket the first deeper Veyrhold district loop with starter wares, city-scrip prices, accessory comparison copy, and a one-choice ledger job that updates rewards and reputation.
acceptance: Oathmarket starter wares are validated
Ledger choices are validated and mutually clear
The /hq Map and Kit drawers expose the first district economy/job loop

tracks.label: Warden's Steps forge and armor runtime
tracks.summary: Make Warden's Steps the first armor-focused Veyrhold district loop with helm, armor, gloves, and boots fittings plus civic oath contracts that teach quality progression, silhouette changes, rewards, and reputation.
acceptance: Warden's Steps armor fittings cover helm, armor, gloves, and boots
Civic oath contracts are validated and reward local-first reputation/items
The /hq Map and Armory drawers expose the first armor forge loop

tracks.label: Bellroot Commons alchemy and mystery runtime
tracks.summary: Make Bellroot Commons the first soft-support Veyrhold district loop with safe alchemy brews, Ilo-led oath-lamp readings, recovery rewards, mystery clues, and compact Map/Kit/Journal proof.
acceptance: Bellroot Commons brews are validated and reward local-first recovery items
Ilo lamp readings are validated and record durable mystery flags
The /hq Map, Kit, and Journal drawers expose the first alchemy/story support loop

tracks.label: Prologue visual assets replacement
tracks.summary: The first Bellroot prologue SVG/glyph sheets were rejected by operator review because they read like dashboard icons, not production RPG art. They are retained for provenance only and must be replaced with high-fidelity painted/rendered 2D or approved-pack art before this track can close.
tracks.runtimeSurface: /hq Adventure, Journal, Map, People, and Assets drawers
acceptance: No flat vector/glyph prologue sheets appear as production game art
Replacement assets use high-fidelity painted/rendered 2D or approved-pack sources
Ilo, Bellroot, and intro prop visuals are manifest-tracked only after operator visual approval

tracks.label: Illustrated world and codex runtime
tracks.summary: Approved illustrated seed sheets now lead broader /hq RPG surfaces: hotbar and skill tree icons, selected map/city location cards, combat codex enemy cards, and companion portrait chips.
tracks.runtimeSurface: /hq hotbar, Skills, Map, Journal/Codex, and People drawers
acceptance: Skill and hotbar actions use illustrated VFX icons
Map and city storylines use location cards
Combat codex and companion rows use illustrated cards before text fallback

tracks.label: Arsenal visuals and itemization
tracks.summary: Weapon families, quality overlays, named weapon cards, drop/upgrade VFX, item comparison, quality caps, deterministic affixes, and loot/equip/upgrade proof are being wired through /hq Kit, Gear, loadout, and reward surfaces; next expansion carries the same quality ladder into helmets, armor, gloves, boots, necklaces, and rings.
tracks.runtimeSurface: /hq Kit, Gear, loadout, and Assets drawers
acceptance: 21 weapon families and 7 quality overlays are manifest-tracked
Named weapon drops can be collected, equipped, upgraded, compared, and salvaged
Quality visuals and low-flash VFX cues appear without crowding the playfield

tracks.label: Optional generator-assisted game art
tracks.summary: GPT Image 2, Seedance 2.0, and guarded sprite helper tools are supported only as operator-approved optional tools for the illustrated 2D bench, with prompt records, rights review, no forced paid dependency, and manifest validation.
acceptance: Generator outputs cannot ship without provenance
No generated asset can create a forced paid dependency

tracks.label: Real asset intake
tracks.summary: Import approved real character, armor, weapon, prop, texture, and preview assets once operator-provided packs exist locally; this is now optional/reference material behind the illustrated 2D primary path.
acceptance: Official pack files are placed under assets/arpg/intake/raw or extracted work folders
Imported files are manifest-tracked and previewable

tracks.label: Production art, audio, and VFX
tracks.summary: First-town presentation cues now stage ambient copy, VFX intent, audio intent, approved runtime asset references, and reduced-motion alternatives for Bellroot and Veyrhold while final imported art/audio remains open.
acceptance: Runtime uses approved existing art where assets exist
Rejected prologue glyph sheets stay out of production preview
Reduced-motion and low-flash alternatives remain calm

tracks.label: Full HUD, menus, maps, and codex
tracks.summary: The validated 14-panel menu matrix now drives compact production menu launchers for start/continue, character, inventory, armory, skills, journal, codex, maps, reputation, companions, controls, credits, and recovery.
acceptance: All 14 menu launchers route to real drawers
Active menu context explains the opened surface
Tutorial, controls, codex, map, and recovery surfaces stay compact and playfield-safe

tracks.label: Save migration and recovery
tracks.summary: Versioned v3 saves now persist autosave/manual/checkpoint slots, load selected slots, export/import envelopes and raw saves, block corrupted imports, and require reset confirmation.
acceptance: Old saves migrate without losing progress
Manual and checkpoint slots are real local actions
Corrupted imports fail safely
Reset requires confirmation

tracks.label: Content tooling
tracks.summary: Production content tooling now has a typed registry, dedicated validation gate, authoring helpers, fixture save map, progression checks, and docs for safe zone/content additions.
acceptance: No orphaned content references
Adding a zone has documented fixture and validation steps
Dev-only debug helpers remain a documented contract, not public player controls

tracks.label: Balance and playtest fixtures
tracks.summary: Full-game balance and playtest fixtures now validate XP/session targets, loot cadence, boss timing, potion pressure, class and lineage viability, upgrade economy, browser budgets, and city/act/endgame checklists.
acceptance: Balance fixtures cover prologue, acts, all 12 cities, final boss, and endgame
Performance budgets, class viability, and economy targets are validated and visible in /hq

tracks.label: Release-grade test gates
tracks.summary: Expand unit/static/E2E/browser coverage for the complete RPG and close the MW6 parent only after all gates pass.
acceptance: Complete RPG flows are covered
Resources and handoffs reflect closure
